Paste your references in the box below. Press the button, then if there are errors they will be reported, and you can preview and grab your results from the box on the right - click on the box and they're copied.

You can use English, French or Paratext book names (GEN EXO etc) as well as common abbreviations - check the button to the right to see all working names and abbreviations. You can include accents or not on your names and abbreviations, they get removed during the search process.

You can have : or . separators, you can do ranges (MAT 8.9-14) or whole chapters (MAT 8), but not skipped verses (MAT 8.5, 6, 14) or ranges across chapters (Matt 8-9).

viewSuggestedCollections: Xool mboolooy leeral yi nu la digal
bulkVerseCopyInstructions:
Bindal aaya yi nga bëgg duppi ci néeg bi ci suuf. Cuqal butoŋ bi; su fekké am na njuumte dinañu la ko won, te man nga xool li génn ci néeg bi ci sa ndeyjoor - cuqal néeg bi ngir duppi aaya yi.

Man nga jëfandikoo turi téere yi ci Angale, Tubab walla turu téerey ni ñu ko binde ci Paratext (GEN EXO ak yeneen) ak itam gàttal yi nu baaxoo di jëfandikoo - xoolal butoŋ bi ci sa ndeyjoor ngir gis tur yi ak gàttal téerey yi ci man baax. Man nga def walla bañ a def tomb yi (accents) ci sa tur yi ak sa gàttal yi, dañu leen di dindi ci saatu bi.

Man nga jëfandikoo : walla . ngir xàjale saar ak aayal, man nga def ay aaya yu toftalo (MAT 8.9-14) walla ab saar yépp (MAT 8), waaye manulo jël aaya yu toftalowul (MAT 8.5, 6, 14) walla saar yu bokkul (Matt 8-9).
